name: Bubble & Bliss
hours: Mon 9 AM–6 PM; Tue 9 AM–6 PM; Wed 9 AM–6 PM; Thu 9 AM–6 PM; Fri 9 AM–6 PM; Sat Closed; Sun Closed

reviews.t: If you want a relaxing pedicure where it doesn't feel like an assembly line, this is it! Kitzi takes the time to do it right!! The atmosphere is just perfect! I will definitely be back!

Bubble & Bliss is a beautiful little (super clean) gem tucked into the center of Black Mountain. Kitzi is the best! She’s been doing my nails and brows for many years, and she does an excellent job every time. This is a rare find.
Kitzi the owner was amazing and so professional the facial was life then I finished off with the most amazing pedicure. All I could say is don’t walk run and book book book.
I highly recommend bubble and bliss. The entire experience was calming and relaxing. Kitzi was so gentle, welcoming and professional throughout the treatment. I will definitely be back!

I had such an incredible experience at Bubble & Bliss! I decided to really treat myself and booked a facial, chemical peel, manicure, pedicure, teeth whitening, and brow lamination — and I genuinely walked out feeling like a new person. What impressed me most was the quality and attention to detail across every single service. Nothing ever felt rushed or like I was just the next appointment on the schedule. Kitzi took her time with me, made sure I was comfortable throughout everything, and you can tell she genuinely cares about both the quality of her work and the results her clients see. I have acne scarring, and I can truly tell a difference in my skin after my facial and chemical peel. My skin looks smoother, brighter, and more even, and seeing an actual improvement in the appearance of my scarring was such a pleasant surprise. Kitzi was also incredibly knowledgeable throughout the process and made me feel completely comfortable with what she was doing and what to expect. My manicure and pedicure turned out beautifully and felt like an actual spa experience rather than simply getting my nails done. I was also SO impressed with the teeth whitening — there was a noticeable difference when we finished! And my brow lamination may be one of my favorite results. My brows look fuller, polished, and beautifully shaped while still looking natural. Beyond the services themselves, Kitzi is what makes Bubble & Bliss so special. She is warm, welcoming, professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly attentive. I felt comfortable with her immediately. Even after spending several hours there getting different treatments, it never felt tedious — it honestly felt like spending the day with a friend while being completely pampered. I also love that I can go to one place for skincare, a chemical peel, nails, teeth whitening, and brows without feeling like I’m compromising on the quality of any one service. Everything was done with the same level of care and attention. I left Bubble & Bliss feeling relaxed, polished, refreshed, and genuinely more confident. If you’re looking for a spa where you’ll feel cared for from the moment you walk in AND actually see results from your services, I cannot recommend Kitzi and Bubble & Bliss enough. I’m already looking forward to my next appointment!

Omg, by far the best facial I have had. I'm definitely going to make it a point to treat myself again. Kitzi was so professional and aims to please the client. The Feng shui, the fountain going, gave the experience of serenity and peace. I would give it a 10 star if I could.

Kitzi did an amazing job on my manicure! She was precise and careful with my sensitive cuticles. She helped me pick out the perfect color. I had picked out a sheer color on accident and she helped me pick out a color that better suited my needs (I didn’t want sheer) The shop was clean and cute & Kitzi was professional and friendly. 10/10 will be back again!

My face is absolutely glowing and I’ve been taking selfies all day. Not only did I get an extremely exceptional micro needling treatment, but the salon its self was amazing! The smell, the tranquil sound, the ambient lighting…. It felt like full scale, top of the line pampering!! Kitzi has the perfect touch that you just have to be born with and really cares about your personal needs. All around a great person, great treatment, great salon. I would recommend her to anyone who wants quality service.
